correctness.rationale: Verified the finite K_(r+1)-free extension/type correspondence using Henson Theorem 2.3 and Conant Section 3. A unary neighborhood is valid iff it misses a part. For adjacent x,y a forbidden common K_(r-1) occurs precisely for the unique part i missed by both and common neighbors in all other parts, giving the disjoint B correction. Factoring U=2^N s(1+O_r(s)) and B=4^N sum p_i^2(1+O_r((3/4)^min n)) gives uniform collision asymptotic. Cauchy-Schwarz and discreteness of powers 2^{-n_i} give balanced equality. Fresh independent finite checks used 63 r=2..4 size vectors N<=7; not an infinite proof.
